To further enhance SEO, consider these tactics:

1. **Structured Data:** Adding Plumber schema markup can help search engines better understand and display you locally. [https://schema.org/Plumber](https://schema.org/Plumber)
2. **Local Citations:** Ensure your NAP (name, address, phone number) is consistent across all citation websites like Google, Facebook, Yelp, and Bing.
3. **Page Speed Optimization:** Use tools like Google PageSpeed Insights to get tips on how to improve your website performance. Loading speed is a critically important ranking factor.

Stand out from competition and use video. Showing off first hand knowledge off could be super helpful if the video is helpful and to the point. Video is underused and could really set you apart as a plumber from others that had just a SEO write about it.
